decision.reason: [ev-089778a9e2c3] only says "allow v prefix for bottlerocket aliases". It does not say which field, resource or setting holds the alias, and none of the other Bug Fixes items or any upgrade-guide text names it. An alias value accepted by a configuration field is not wire or protocol behaviour, so the protocol-behavior subject is probably the wrong family. The right subject would most likely be a crd-field, but nothing shown gives its group, kind or path. Settling the subject and confirming that this is a relaxed acceptance (behavior-changed) needs the PR #6736 diff or documentation naming the alias field and the formats it accepted before and after.
